description: Auto mains failure generator controller over GenComm (Modbus RTU): status and mode, generator and mains instrumentation, engine and ECU data, power, energy and run hours, named alarms and system control keys
source: Deep Sea Electronics, DSE7310 GenComm (SP-228 rev A), pages 3-7, 16 and 154

sources.title: DSE7310 GenComm
sources.note: section 8: pages 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 16 and 154 (72xx/73xx family list); copy hosted by a distributor, Wincogen

notes: Address = page x 256 + register offset (page 4 offset 0, oil pressure, is register 1024). Read with function 3; system control keys are written with function 16.
32-bit values are two registers, high word first.
Unimplemented or out-of-range values read as the GenComm sentinels (0xFFFF, 0x7FFF and the 32-bit equivalents). Many engine (page 5) values only exist with a CAN ECU.
Named alarms (page 154, 72xx/73xx list): four 4-bit alarm conditions per register, the first in bits 12-15. Page 8, the old alarm system, is not used by this family.
Registers that GenComm defines for other DSE families (bus, S1/S2 sources, DC plant, battery chargers, 8661 load) are left out; page 6 uses the 8xxx/7xxx allocation.
Serial settings follow the controller configuration; 9600 8N2 is the GenComm default used by the other DSE maps.
Written from the manufacturer's GenComm document; not tested on a device.
